en.title: Plan statistical analyses
en.description: Choose tests, check assumptions, and report effect sizes and uncertainty.
tasks: Choose tests, check assumptions, and report effect sizes and uncertainty.
prerequisites: Python and analysis packages such as scipy, statsmodels, pingouin, and pandas.
en.example: Use statistical-analysis. Compare these two groups, explain the test assumptions, and report effect size with uncertainty.
en.expectedResult: An analysis rationale, assumption checks, and interpretable result tables.
limitations: Data quality and study design determine validity; significance alone is not a useful conclusion.

zh.title: 规划统计分析
zh.description: 选择检验方法、检查假设，并报告效应量与不确定性。
tasks: 选择检验方法、检查假设，并报告效应量与不确定性。
prerequisites: Python 及 scipy、statsmodels、pingouin、pandas 等分析包。
zh.example: 请使用 statistical-analysis：比较这两组数据，解释检验假设，并报告效应量和不确定性。
zh.expectedResult: 分析依据、假设检查及可解释的结果表。
limitations: 结果有效性取决于数据质量与研究设计，显著性本身不足以构成结论。
